target_customer: Payments platforms, ISOs, PayFacs and sponsor banks; originally fintechs underwriting SMBs
problem: Traditional bureaus cover small businesses poorly, so risk shows up only at chargebacks or defaults, and merchant onboarding and risk operations are manual.
business_model: B2B SaaS/API for merchant risk underwriting, monitoring and fraud detection

founders.name: Shyam Maddali
founders.background_notes: A third-party profile says seven years at WePay (JPMorgan Chase) before Coris.

competitors.name: Middesk
competitors.what: Business identity verification and underwriting data via API

competitors.name: Alloy
competitors.what: Identity and risk decisioning platform; added credit underwriting in early 2022
competitors.traction_then: more than 300 companies on the API, 160+ data sources (2022-09)
competitors.funding_then: $52M extra round Sept 2022 at reported $1.55B valuation

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating unstructured SMB web data and building risk models is standard data engineering with hard modeling parts.

defensibility.rationale: Data and workflow integrations help, but funded identity and risk vendors already sold to the same buyers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: VentureBeat (2024-02) says incumbents were slow to adopt NLP; no acquisition or copy of Coris found through 2026.

market_need_then: YC launch post: bureau SMB coverage is poor, integrations painful, data unstructured; founders spent 20+ years in payments risk. VentureBeat 2024-02 cites 150,000 SMBs verified and a Mindbody case (onboarding 5x faster).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, outcome-focused ('building the trust layer for commerce')

brand_strength.rationale: Short invented name; no brand press, mascot or community evidence found, and no source says the name helped.

pivots.from: Risk API with alternative data and monitoring for fintechs underwriting SMBs
pivots.to: AI risk platform for payments platforms, ISOs, PayFacs and sponsor banks (agents, transaction monitoring, ForgeCheck)
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the YC launch post versus the current site

outcome_analysis: Coris is active and raised a $3.7M seed in February 2024 co-led by Lux and Exponent, with a reported 150,000 SMBs verified and named customers. Founders with PayPal, WePay and eBay risk experience give strong founder-market fit, and the product widened from an SMB data API to an AI risk platform with fraud and verification modules. Later rounds and revenue are not public, and funded rivals like Middesk and Alloy already served the same buyers at founding.
notes: Seed confirmed by VentureBeat (2024-02-01) and fintech.global (2024-02-02). Unverified: CB Insights lists $4.2M over 3 rounds including a 2022 convertible note; not recorded. Exponent is also written 'Exponent Founders Capital'. A third-party profile says W22 while the directory says Summer 2022 (directory kept). Pivot entry is my reading of the YC launch post versus the current site, date approximate. Name origin not found.
